## AC AMENDMENT APPLIED TO THE DESCRIPTION (it had only ever been recorded in a comment)

The amendment reasoning was recorded in the preceding comment, but the ticket's **description** still
carried the original 15 criteria, all unchecked — criteria that specify emitting a link removal, which
is precisely the behaviour the operator ruling deferred. Left that way, this ticket could never close
except by force, and a future reader diffing description against comments would find them in conflict.

The description's Acceptance criteria section now reads:

 * **7 criteria that stand**, describing what this ticket actually shipped — all checked, each against
   evidence already recorded on this ticket (the apply-layer DROP fix in 1276 and its mutation proof;
   G1/G2/G3/G5 landed and mutation-proven; the stated local-wins-and-restore semantics; the ecosystem
   research with sources; the refutation of the original `managed_refs` design with its probe; the
   correct design recorded with 1296 as a working template; both modules under the 800-LOC cap).
 * **1 criterion still open** — the live cell is XFAIL with the full reason, `strict=False`, not
   inverted and not deleted. That is **Gerrit change 1303**, which is not merged yet. It is the only
   thing standing between this ticket and closure.
 * **15 RETIRED criteria, preserved VERBATIM** under a `RETIRED` heading and rendered as
   `~~RETIRED~~` records rather than checkboxes. They are not outstanding work, so they must not
   read as unchecked boxes; but they are also not to be silently dropped, which is why the original
   wording is kept in full alongside the reason it no longer applies.

**This is not amending away a coverage gap.** The distinction the operator drew on 5200's row 12 was:
do not amend away a COVERAGE gap. The cell here still exists and still runs — as an xfail that fails
loudly on xpass — so coverage is retained and a future fix cannot land unnoticed. What changed is the
product decision about what behaviour to ship.

## HARNESS CONFIRMATION — the cell is still RED, which is why 1303 is warranted

Run **30834117797** (main @ `25ead49f3e`), `test_inbound_delete_link_round_trips` FAILED. Verbatim:

> the Jira link was DELETED (confirmed absent from the search-backed link read) but the local dep on
> jira-rbjskzw-1 still targets 'jira-rbjskzw-2': deps target ['jira-rbjskzw-2']. The inbound link
> differ is ADD-only (`inbound_differ.py:380,396`).

So the deferral is grounded in a live observation on current main, not only in the earlier analysis:
the merged fix from 1276 genuinely does not mirror the removal, exactly as this ticket concluded.
1303 marks that reality in the suite instead of leaving a permanently-red cell.
